Maria (PM): Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — want to lock owners and timelines for the INF-2026 remediation items. Can we do a quick round?
Kevin (Eng): I can own the config rollback and the CI gating work. Tentative ETA: 1 week for rollback doc + 3 weeks for CI gating.
Dan (SRE): I'll take the alert tuning and runbook updates. Will spin up a small doc and link the runbook PR. ETA: 3 business days for runbook draft.
Olivia (Platform): I can own the capacity-autoscale policy changes and a short QA plan. Need to coordinate with Kevin for staging test. ETA: 2 weeks.
Maria (PM): Great — assigning tickets now. I'll create INF-2026-01 (config rollback) INF-2026-02 (CI gating) INF-2026-03 (alert tuning/runbook) INF-2026-04 (autoscale policy + QA).
incident-bot: Created INF-2026-01, INF-2026-02, INF-2026-03, INF-2026-04 in Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2026-01
Kevin (Eng): @Maria thanks — linking my branch and draft notes here: https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/config-rollback
Dan (SRE): FYI on RACI: for INF-2026-03 I propose R=Dan, A=Maria, C=Kevin, I=oncall rotation. OK?
Maria (PM): Agree with that RACI. I'll add it to the ticket description and the postmortem doc.
Olivia (Platform): For INF-2026-04, call out acceptance criteria: 1) no >2x latency under 75th pct load, 2) autoscale triggers validated in staging, 3) runbook steps updated. I'll add those to the ticket.
Kevin (Eng): Quick note: CI gating needs a small infra change that might require a short maintenance window. Suggest we schedule during low-traffic hours.
Dan (SRE): +1 schedule window. I'll coordinate with infra calendar and ping ops.
Maria (PM): I'll create a milestone board for these four tickets and set due dates: INF-2026-01 due 2056006840 (1 week), INF-2026-03 due 2056083240 (3 days), INF-2026-02 due 2057600000 (3 weeks), INF-2026-04 due 2057500000 (2 weeks).
Kevin (Eng): Acked.
Olivia (Platform): Acked.
Dan (SRE): Acked.
Maria (PM): One more ask — please add a short "how to validate" checklist in each ticket (2-3 bullets). That will help the QA handoff.
Kevin (Eng): Will do in INF-2026-01 and INF-2026-02.
Olivia (Platform): I'll add the validation bullets for INF-2026-04.
Dan (SRE): Adding runbook validation steps to INF-2026-03 now.
Maria (PM): Perfect — I'll follow up at Thursday sync with a quick status update. If anything slips, flag here or on the ticket. :thumbsup:
Kevin (Eng): :thumbsup:
Dan (SRE): :eyes:
Olivia (Platform): Thanks — closing this thread when tickets are updated.
